weaknesses.title: MEDIANF even-n lower mid only — no mean-of-two / float P50
weaknesses.detail: Even count uses lower mid (SYS MEDIAN convention). Agents cannot get average of two central samples without custom bag sort.

weaknesses.title: MULFALL integer factor only — no fractional decay
weaknesses.detail: Cannot scale lat_ms by 0.5 for half-life without integer tricks (×5/10). Factor 0 zeros all.

weaknesses.title: MULFALL unfiltered — scales entire class
weaknesses.detail: Cannot scale only hot probes; need SENDBETWEEN/WHEREGE + per-object or accept fleet-wide scale.

weaknesses.title: admit uses med_n - thr_n compare; stored LET IF still risky
weaknesses.detail: Worked with over = med_n - thr_n; IF over < 1. Direct IF med_n <= thr_n may still flake after OOP query.
